text:
Anika: ok team quick pet thread — meet Nimbus, the cat who thinks every sink is a throne. pic: https://i.imgur.com/nimbus1.jpg :cat2:
Tom: LOL he looks like he just filed three expense reports and refused to approve yours :laughing:
Priya: sink naps are iconic. also that angle makes him look like a tiny lion ":lion_face:"
Raj: here's my golden getting in on the chaos. he refused to wear socks but agreed to a bow tie. pic: https://i.imgur.com/goldie_bow.jpg :bow:
Zoe: bow tie or not, Goldie is CEO material. hiring immediately.
LoquiBot: reminder: office pet days need pet waiver signed by 2PM friday. link: https://hr.internal/forms/pet-waiver
Anika: oops thanks @LoquiBot — will sign. Nimbus is vaccinated and demands cookies as an onboarding perk :cookie:
Tom: quick poll: who wants to bring pets to Tuesday's cafe social? React :raised_hand: or :no_entry_sign:
Priya: raising hand, will bring a small carrier with Mr. Whiskers (very polite)
Raj: sadly no, our golden faces separation anxiety. will visit instead for snacks and head pats
Zoe: can we get a tiny throne for Nimbus in the breakout? he deserves it.
Anika: yes. also bonus pic of Nimbus attempting to high-five: https://i.imgur.com/nimbus2.gif :sparkles:
Tom: that GIF is everything. saving to doggo/kitty folder rn :floppy_disk:
Priya: caption contest: "When the snack table opens and you realize it's all tuna" winner gets a virtual cat treat :treat:
Raj: "Executive judgment in progress" my vote
Zoe: "I will accept this report" runner-up
Anika: you all are terrible and perfect. thanks for the love :heart:
